description:
Picking up where we left off in part 1, Sam Shamoun (@shamounian) returns as we continue refuting a response from the "official" Advent Defense League (@AdventDefenseLeague) wherein they claimed to have easily refuted Sam on what the Bible teaches regarding death and the state of the dead. Along the way, we also see the numerous Christological heresies that permeate Adventist theology and thought.
